topics.topic: Division of validation responsibility between route handlers and photo_delivery
questions: Do the deliverer_api handlers perform every check contained in A3 rule 4, A4 rule 2 and A5 rule 9, or only token, request-form, project-id and photo-id checks before photo_delivery performs connection, folder, source-id, lock and placement checks?

quotes:
The checks of A5 rules 1, 5, 9 and 10, A3 rule 4 and A4 rule 2 run in
the handlers of `module:deliverer_api`.

1. The delivery route that `capability:deliverer_router.create_app` built passes the request to its handler in `module:deliverer_api`, which checks the token, the request form and the
   project id.
2. `capability:photo_delivery.deliver_project_photo` asks `capability:object_connections.confirmed_connection`
   and `capability:object_connections.available_photo_folder`, then checks the form of the source id.
judgement.divergence: One passage assigns all checks of A3 rule 4 and A5 rule 9 to deliverer_api, permitting source-id validation in the handler; the flow assigns connection and folder checks followed by source-id validation to photo_delivery, so the HTTP caller sees `invalid_source_id` versus `unknown_project` for the same request.
judgement.why: The State 5 enforcement sentence assigns whole rules to the handlers while the accepted flow assigns only boundary validation to the handler and leaves connection, folder and source-id checks to photo_delivery.
